mcqs.question: In a Venn diagram of two sets A and B, which region correctly represents the elements that belong to set A only (i.e., not to B)?

options.A: Region common to both A and B (the overlapping part)
options.B: Region that lies only in set A (outside the overlap with B)
options.C: Region that lies only in set B (outside the overlap with A)
options.D: Region outside both A and B (outside the circles)

mcqs.answer: Region that lies only in set A (outside the overlap with B)
mcqs.explanation: The part of set A that does not intersect set B is the portion of circle A that lies outside the overlapping area. Option B describes this region. Option A is the intersection, Option C belongs to B only, and Option D is the complement of A∪B, not A alone.

mcqs.question: In a Venn diagram with two circles C (cricket players) and F (football players), which region represents the union C ∪ F (students who play cricket or football or both)?

options.A: Only the part of C that does not overlap with F
options.B: Only the part of F that does not overlap with C
options.C: Only the overlapping part of C and F
options.D: All parts of both circles C and F, including the overlapping part

mcqs.answer: All parts of both circles C and F, including the overlapping part
mcqs.explanation: The union of two sets includes every element that is in either set or in both. Hence the entire area covered by both circles, including the overlap, represents C ∪ F. Options A and B give only the exclusive parts, and C gives only the intersection, not the full union.

mcqs.question: In a Venn diagram with sets A and B drawn inside a universal set U, which region correctly represents the complement of (A ∪ B)?

options.A: The area inside set A only
options.B: The area inside set B only
options.C: The area outside both A and B but still inside U
options.D: The area inside the intersection of A and B

mcqs.answer: The area outside both A and B but still inside U
mcqs.explanation: The complement of (A ∪ B) consists of all elements that are in the universal set U but not in A or B. This is the region outside both circles while remaining inside U. Options A and B are parts of A or B, and D is the intersection, none of which are the complement of the union.

mcqs.learning_point: Solve counting problems using Venn diagrams
mcqs.question: In a class of 100 students, 60 study Mathematics, 45 study Physics, and 30 study both subjects. Using a Venn diagram, how many students study neither Mathematics nor Physics?
mcqs.explanation: Number studying at least one of the subjects = |M| + |P| – |M∩P| = 60 + 45 – 30 = 75. Students studying neither = total – 75 = 100 – 75 = 25. Hence option A is correct; the other numbers do not match the calculation.
